dialogues.speaker: Echoing Conch
dialogues.text: "Alright, Zakhar. We're done with the signal testing on this island... Let's hope the machine starts up without any issues..."

dialogues.speaker: Echoing Conch
dialogues.text: "Okay, okay. Come on, let's get to the next island and finish what we came to do... the sooner we complete our assignment, the sooner I can go back to camp and rest..."
